subject: Dedicated inference capacity — alignment call to plan architecture deep-dive
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated inference capacity — alignment call to plan architecture deep-dive

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, FinPay is evaluating a dedicated GPU deployment for inference (pool sizing, autoscaling policies, and tenant isolation constraints). We'd like to run a focused technical deep-dive with your infra and platform folks so we can map expected traffic patterns to recommended pool topologies and validation tests.

Proposed outcomes:
- Agree on capacity targets (p99 latency targets, concurrent sessions, batch profiles)
- Define autoscaling trigger candidates and burst strategies
- Identify isolation options (tenant/network/VM-level) and compliance constraints
- Next steps and owners for a 2-week pilot

I have attached a short pre-read that summarizes our model performance assumptions and the kinds of metrics we’ll ask for. Can you confirm who from your side should join? Below are a few available slots (all PT):
- Tue 2026-10-06 09:00–10:00
- Tue 2026-10-06 13:00–14:00
- Wed 2026-10-07 11:00–12:00

If none of those work, propose three windows that do. We’ll circulate an agenda and a short design doc ahead of time.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: dedicated-capacity-pre-read.pdf (7 pages)
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 19:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated inference capacity — alignment call to plan architecture deep-dive

Aditya —

Thanks for the note and the pre-read — helpful. I’ll have Tom (Platform Lead) and Priya (security/compliance) join. The 10/06 13:00–14:00 PT slot looks good for our team. Blocking now.

Two quick asks before the call: can you include some guidance on expected KV cache sizing for persistent-chat workloads and an example failover flow if a pool becomes degraded? Also share any runbook checklist we should review.

Sarah
VP Product Ops, FinPay

Looping in a proposed agenda and a short checklist we should cover during the session. I’ll lead the parts on autoscaling policies and failure modes. Karthik — can you draft a short slide on isolation options (VPC, tenant namespaces, GPU partitioning) and an example test matrix?

Draft agenda (30–45 min):
1) Quick intros + current infra constraints (5 min)
2) Workload profile review (p95/p99, batch sizes, KV-cache expectations) (10 min)
3) Pool topologies & sizing recommendations (10 min)
4) Autoscale triggers, cooldowns, burst strategies (10 min)
5) Isolation & failover walkthrough (10 min)
6) Action items / pilot next steps (5 min)

Attachments: initial-agenda.md

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@finpay.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated inference capacity — alignment call to plan architecture deep-dive

Thanks everyone — quick note: I put together a short slide (link below) showing three candidate pool topologies (shared slab, isolated tenant pools, and hybrid burst pools) with rough CPU/GPU memory footprints and expected cost delta. Also included example autoscale triggers (queue depth, CPU/GPU utilization, p95 latency) and a basic isolation test plan (network egress check, tenant eviction test).

Preview link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdExampleLink/edit
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FP-2026-09-RED-41

If FinPay has any additional metric exports (sample hour of qps and token-distribution), bring those to the call — they’ll let us tighten sizing.

-karthik
